title: The Pig’s Hat
description: A hat, a pot, and a very muddy pig.
notice: A make-believe adventure with Anna and Sarah. Read and choose, or listen together.
script:
story 2
variable pot = false hidden
scene pig-mud
show Anna happy left
show Sarah curious right
show Pig neutral center
camera wide cut
camera wide cut
I: A pig is in the mud.
Anna [curious]: A hat for a pig?
choice hat
option hat "Get a hat." -> hat
option pot "Get a pot." -> pot ; pot = true
label hat
scene pig-hat
show Anna happy left
show Sarah curious right
show Pig happy center
camera wide cut
react Sarah laugh
Sarah [laughing]: The hat fits!
goto play
label pot
scene pig-pot
show Anna happy left
show Sarah curious right
show Pig curious center
camera wide cut
react Anna laugh
Anna [laughing]: The pot fits!
goto play
label play
I: The pig can play.
choice play
option hop "Hop, pig!" -> hop
option sit "Sit, pig!" -> sit
label hop
move Pig bounce
Sarah [happy]: Hop! Hop! Mud on us!
goto rest
label sit
react Sarah laugh
Sarah [laughing]: Plop! A bum in the mud!
goto rest
label rest
Anna [happy]: A fun day! Time to rest.
choice rest
option hug "A hug." -> hug
option nap "A nap." -> nap
label hug
react Anna excited
Anna [happy]: A big hug. Mud on me!
goto endcheck
label nap
rest Sarah downcast
Sarah [happy]: Shh! The pig can nap.
goto endcheck
label endcheck
if pot == true -> potend else hatend
label potend
scene pig-pot
show Anna happy left
show Sarah curious right
show Pig curious center
camera wide cut
I: A pot for a hat. It fits just right!
goto finish
label hatend
scene pig-hat
show Anna happy left
show Sarah curious right
show Pig happy center
camera wide cut
I: A hat for a pig. It fits just right!
goto finish
label finish
Anna [happy]: I love this pig!
end

Anna.name: Anna
Anna.provenance: Storybook adaptation for Chunky Reader; shared polished SVG builder, not a likeness.

Sarah.name: Sarah
Sarah.provenance: Storybook adaptation for Chunky Reader; shared polished SVG builder, not a likeness.
